name: Homepage loads with key content
goal: Look at the homepage. Scroll down the page to the bottom, viewing the lab description, research areas, news and footer.
expected: The page shows the lab name (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Lab / U-AIM), a research description, research area cards (Physical AI, Agentic AI, Image/Video/Speech Diffusion), a News section, and a footer, with no broken layout or missing images.

name: Navigate to Research page
goal: Use the top navigation menu to open the 'Research' page.
expected: A Research page opens (URL contains research) showing the lab's research areas content, with the same site header/navigation still visible.

name: Navigate to Publications page
goal: Use the top navigation menu to open the 'Publications' page (hover over or click 'Publications' and choose Conferences/Journals or International if a submenu appears).
expected: A Publications page opens listing publications (paper titles/authors/venues).

name: Navigate to Family members page
goal: Use the top navigation menu to open the 'Family' page (the lab members section, e.g. Professor).
expected: A page opens showing the professor and/or lab members with names or photos.

name: Search works
goal: Use the site's Search box to search for the word 'diffusion' and submit the search.
expected: A search results page appears listing results related to 'diffusion', or a clear 'no results' message. It must not show an error or blank page.

name: News section links to a news item
goal: Scroll to the News section on the homepage and click the 'Link' of the first news item.
expected: The news item's detail page (or linked page) opens with readable content and no error page.
